title: AppResponse
description: P02 app-owned production design baseline; no production route is implemented. All limits are transport ceilings, not launch policy. HDE ready projection is deliberately unavailable pending A01/A07.

LatestMessageMarker.description: A conversation's latest message over the rows the member may see: Glow's submission ID and Glow's time only, never text (P06.2 C1; DM-22 6.1).

ConversationSummary.description: One conversation of the member's list: Glow's state, the count of the other member's accepted messages after the member's own read cursor, and the latest-message marker. No provider field; no reason why a conversation ended (P06.2 C1, OD-45).

ConversationList.description: The member's conversations, answered from Glow's rows with no provider call; a conversation the member may no longer see is not listed (P06.2 C1).

ConversationMessage.description: One message of a page, from Glow's rows: Glow's submission ID, own or other, Glow's time, the text Glow sent or the one unavailable state with no reason, and for own messages the delivery state. No provider ID, timestamp or field (P06.2 C1; DM-22 2.1, 6.2).

MessagePage.description: A page of one conversation: at most 50 accepted messages in the order they became visible, then, on the newest page only, the member's own pending and failed submissions (at most 50). Cursors are opaque and bound to the match they were issued for (P06.2 C1; DM-22 6.4).

MessagePageRequest.description: A page request for one conversation: no cursor for the newest page, or a cursor a page returned for that match (P06.2 C1).

ReadCursorIntent.description: Move the member's own read cursor forward to an accepted message of the match. A monotone, idempotent command: a repeat, a replay or a cursor behind the current one changes nothing, so it carries no CommandMeta (P06.2 C1).

contact_email.description: ASCII public-request contact locator only; delivery/ownership must be verified by maintained auth. This is not a complete email-address grammar.
ASCII public-request contact locator only; delivery/ownership must be verified by maintained auth. This is not a complete email-address grammar.

CommandReceipt.description: Immutable minimal interaction-family receipt. This is the original logical outcome, not a current projection or permission. No actor, profile data, private response or contact capability is retained.

InteractionCommandResult.description: Internal fixture-command result catalog; no HTTP route or deployed contract activation. Receipt is original and immutable; projection is rebuilt under current actor/object access and may be null. Replay never regrants contact. Existing AppResponse does not silently accept this new discriminator.

OwnWords.description: A member's own words for their gender or orientation (SV2, D3): display only, never matched, searched or ranked; at most 40 Unicode scalar values. Orientation's are sensitive: saved only with the sensitive-fields consent.

AreaId.description: A core-based statistical area's stable ID, the Census Bureau's GEOID (SV2, D5).

ProfileFieldIntent.description: One of the four two-way list fields, with its own words and display choice, as a new choice (SV2, D3): list value IDs of the current catalog (policy_version), within the field's pick limit, or ["not-stated"] for orientation or relationship status. Orientation, relationship status and orientation's own words need the sensitive-fields consent. Looking for is always shown and has no own words; relationship status has no own words.

OwnFieldValue.description: The member's own value in one field (SV2, D3), for its owner only: version 0 when the field was never saved. choose_again: a value the member holds is retired, so the member chooses again at their next edit; it stays valid and matchable until then.

OwnProfileFields.description: The owner's own four list fields (SV2, D3), never returned to anyone else; policy_version is the catalog version the read was made under.

FiltersIntent.description: The member's age range, never below 18, and distance choice, one of the catalog's (SV2, D4, D5). A distance choice counts areas whose internal points are within it; no distance is ever returned.

OwnFilters.description: The owner's own age range and distance choice (SV2, D4, D5).

AreaIntent.description: The member's home area, chosen by its ID (SV2, D5); only the area is kept. An area the phone-location query returned is set this way too.

OwnArea.description: The owner's own home area (SV2, D5), or none yet.

AreaQuery.description: The phone's approximate location, sent once, in the request body only (SV2, D5): a query that changes nothing. The coordinates are never stored, logged, returned, echoed in an error or put in the outbox or an idempotency record.

NearestArea.description: The area whose internal point is nearest to the queried location (SV2, D5): no coordinate and no distance.

CatalogValue.description: One list value of the catalog (SV2, D2).

CatalogField.description: One field's current list (SV2, D2): the values offered for new choices, the retired values (for showing a held one only), how many a member may pick (null: any number) and whether members may narrow by it.

ConsentPolicy.description: A consent policy's current version and wording (SV2, D6): development text, labelled as such, until P08 writes it.

ProfileCatalog.description: The member's current catalog, read-only (SV2, D2, D11): the lists, which may be narrowed, the defaults, the ways of locating and the distance choices (labels only), and the consent policies' current versions. policy_version is the catalog's version, which ProfileFieldIntent, PreferencesIntent and FiltersIntent carry. In PreferenceSelection.accepted_option_ids, a set that keeps all is exactly ["all"], which includes values the console adds later and "not stated"; a narrowed set lists live values only and never holds "all" or "not-stated".

OwnCompletion.description: The owner's completion read (SV2, D9, D11): what the profile still needs before it can show, from a closed list of its own. identity_verification is the verification company's check of a photo ID (or a staff approval without it), not OnboardingEligibility's verify_identity, which is email verification.

SensitiveConsentIntent.description: The sensitive-fields consent (SV2, D6; G-10): needed before orientation, relationship status or orientation's own words are saved, and before either field's set is narrowed. An acceptance names the policy's current version. A withdrawal removes those values and resets both sets to all.

OwnSensitiveConsent.description: The owner's own sensitive-fields consent (SV2, D6); never required for completion.

AdultCheckIntent.description: The adult check's self-entered birth date, at the eligibility step (SV2, D7): 18 or over on the server's date passes; a failing date is refused and not stored. A new date reruns the check.

OwnAgeState.description: The owner's own age state (SV2, D7): the date that passed the adult check, present with self_declared_adult and absent with unknown.
